literal_meaning: নান্দীর মুখ (নান্দী: শিবের বুল; মুখ: মুখ বা প্রারম্ভ)
example_sentences_in_bangla: নাটকের নান্দীমুখে শুভকামনা প্রকাশ করা হলো।
example_sentences_in_english: The nandi mukh of the wedding ceremony has been completed.
The opening ritual of the play expressed auspicious wishes.
history: Derived from the Nandi śloka in classical Sanskrit literature, an introductory verse invoking blessings from Nandi, Shiva's bull, used at the start of performances, texts, and rituals.
note: Commonly used in Hindu-Bengali cultural contexts for formal beginnings.
